A '''hydro-servo bearing''' connected [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to the wingtips of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]]. The short bearing allowed the cannons to elevate or depress by as much as sixty degrees, allowing the A-wing to fire on targets from wider angles. Some A-wings had hydro-servo bearings that allowed the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to swivel the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] through a full three hundred sixty degrees and allow it to fire straight behind the craft.<ref name="SWS" />
